episodes.instruction: Place the white bottle in the black bowl on top of the night stand, place the lemon in the white mug on the window sill, close the open drawer on the nightstand
Put the airpod case on the white plate, then close the first top drawer, then put the white bottle on top of the cabinet
Move the pot backward, move the plate to the right, then close the mini oven door
Close the microwave door, move the white plate to the right, remove the zucchini and purple grapes from the green pot and place them on the white plate
Open the microwave and put the light-green bowl inside it
Close the microwave door, then move the white plate to next to the light green bowl, then put the contents of the light green bowl on the white plate
Close the air fryer, move the salt cellar to the right, close the open upper cabinet door
Put the pink can inside the upper cabinet, close the right cabinet door, move the salt cellar forwards
Open the microwave door then take out the green bowl and put it on the table then close the microwave door
Pick up the light green bowl and move it to the right. Open the microwave and put in the light green bowl.
Open the microwave door, remove the green bowl from the microwave and place it on the table
Pick up the light green bowl and move it to the right. Open the microwave and put in the light green bowl.
Put the white bottle with the yellow lid inside the open drawer on the right then close the drawer
Put the airpod case on the white plate, then close the first top drawer, then put the white bottle on top of the cabinet
Remove the clear bottle from the chopping board and place it on the left side of the counter, close the drawer
Pick the white object on the drawer and put it on the plate, then close the drawer and pick the bottle on the windowsill and put it on the cabinet
Remove the clear bottle from the chopping board and place it on the left side of the counter, close the drawer
Pick the bottle from open drawer and place it near the caps
Remove the clear bottle from the chopping board and place it on the left side of the counter, close the drawer
Close the drawer of the air fryer, open the right upper cabinet door, remove the black bottle from the cabinet and put it on the countertop
Put the orange bowl in the sink, then close the cabinet door above the sink
Close the microwave door, then move the white plate to next to the light green bowl, then put the contents of the light green bowl on the white plate
Open the toaster oven door, remove the plate that is inside it and place the plate atop the toaster oven
Put the metallic bottle atop the toaster oven and then open the oven door
Open the microwave door, place the dark green bowl in it, then close the microwave door
Close the microwave door, then move the white plate to next to the light green bowl, then put the contents of the light green bowl on the white plate
Move the glass bottle to the right of the counter, close the air fryer, then move the cellars to the right of the counter
Close the basket of the air fryer, then move the bottle of salt to the right, then close the right cabinet door
